question: Why does the class that handles UUID serialization in the tagged JSON serialization system enable bidirectional conversion between UUID instances and their hexadecimal string representations?
answer: Because JSON has no native UUID type, the TagUUID serializer must convert UUID objects into a tagged hex string so they can be stored in JSON-based sessions, and convert them back into real UUID objects on load so the session data round-trips with its original types preserved.
